newsitem.title: USA: Miami International fee hearings continue.
newsitem.headline: Miami International fee hearings continue.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Transportation hearings to determine if Miami International Airport's fees are fair were expected to continue for another week, a source close to the hearings said Thursday.
"We expect them to go well into next week," said a government official who asked not to be named. The hearings began last Friday.
Six airlines alleged that with increases in MIA landing fees and rents, they are being required to pay for a fancy new terminal for the exclusive use of AMR Corp's American Airlines.

Washington D.C. Administrative Law Judge Ronnie Yoder must make a decision on the fairness of the fees by Feb. 17. The Department of Transportation will review the decision and issue a final order by March 19.
